data.name: Asif
data.gender_notes: Asif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asif is a respected name meaning 'forgiving' or 'strong'. In Islamic tradition, Asif was the name of the wise scribe and minister of Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon), known for his deep wisdom and command over spiritual knowledge. The name Asif carries the meaning “Forgiving, Strong, Wise Counselor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Asif usually hope their child will grow to embody forgiving, strong, wise counselor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents divine wisdom and inner strength — one who supports leadership with intellect and loyalty.
data.etymology: Asif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgiving, Strong, Wise Counselor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asif total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عسيف
in_arabic.meaning: عسيف يعني الشخص القوي الشديد أو العبد المملوك
in_arabic.long_meaning: عسيف هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص القوي الشديد أو العبد المملوك. ورد ذكر اسم عسيف في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف آية ٣٥ قال تعالى: 'وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ وَلَكِنَّهُ أَشيمَ عَلى نَفْسِهِ فَلَوْلَا إِذًا مَّا جَزَينَاهُ بِمِثْلِ مَا جَزَينَاهُ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِن ذَلِكَ إِنَّكَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ وَلَوْلَا إِذًا مَّا لَبِسَ الْعَزَّ الَّذِي أُعِزَّ بِهِ أَوَلَم يَرَ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ عَسِيفًا مَّملُوكًا لِيُوسُفَ أَوَلَم يَشْكُرْ'

in_urdu.name: عسيف
in_urdu.meaning: عسيف کا مطلب ہے مضبوط یا غلام
in_urdu.long_meaning: عسيف ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط یا غلام۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے اور قرآن کریم میں بھی اس کا ذکر آیا ہے۔ عسيف نام کے حامل افراد کو مضبوط اور قوی سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: असीफ
in_hindi.meaning: असीफ का अर्थ है मजबूत या दास
in_hindi.long_meaning: असीफ एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है मजबूत या दास। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख आया है। असीफ नाम के धारकों को मजबूत और शक्तिशाली माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عسیف
in_pashto.meaning: عسیف د قوي یا غلام معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عسیف یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه راغلی دی. دغه نوم د قوي یا غلام معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو ترمنځ ډیر مشهور دی او د قرآن کریم په شان هم ورته اشاره شوې ده. د عسیف نوم لرونکي کسان قوي او مضبوط ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Asif
in_english.long_meaning: Asif is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning strong or slave. The name Asif is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Yusuf, verse 35. It holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing strength and resilience. The name is popular across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its timeless appeal and profound meaning.

celebrity_usage: Asif Ali Zardari (Former President of Pakistan)
data.cultural_impact: The name Asif is of Arabic origin and is often used among Muslim communities worldwide. Its inherent meaning of forgiveness reflects one of the essential Islamic teachings, emphasizing the importance of showing compassion and forgiveness in daily life as a reflection of Allah's mercy towards us.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Asif reflects the moral and ethical qualities sought after in individuals and leaders, both in the temporal and spiritual worlds. In Islam, it is believed that forgiveness is an essential aspect of faith and is a significant means of purifying one's heart and soul from negative emotions such as anger, hatred, and revenge. By invoking the name Asif, one can be reminded to embody the virtue of forgiveness, drawing closer to Allah through acts of compassion and kindness towards others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Asif in Arabic means "the persistent one" or "the steadfast one". In the spiritual sense, it represents one who remains devoted and committed to their faith and beliefs, even during times of hardship and adversity. The name is a reminder to persevere and stay steadfast on the path towards righteousness.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Asif ibn Bahdal was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Asif carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Asif remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Ahmed Asif in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Asif, which means "Forgiving, Strong, Wise Counselor". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
